payload.description_html: Stegosaurus dorsal plate fragments being exposed during excavation at the Red Canyon Ranch quarry near Shell, Bighorn County, Wyoming, July 2004. Morrison Formation, Upper Jurassic. This excavation recovered the specimen now on display at the Natural History Museum, London.
